scope: Development-side mapping from selected reviewed hypotheses to their current implementation-contract representation; not a case registry, runtime resource, manifest, provider input, training dataset, or hosted authorization.

q01.contract: A planar +Z maximum-output-Z predicate may bind only when candidate cardinality is exactly one; every other cardinality stops before the dependent operation.

q02.contract: The uniquely selected boss-top face is consumed before SketchCircle and the dependent blind CutCylinder.

q03.contract: Selector-cardinality and wrong-face controls are audited in the family-scoped sequence evidence, and post-step geometry/topology expectations remain bounded to that reviewed family.

mappings.boundary: The exact Q01--Q04 fail-closed chain is represented across reviewed knowledge, family-scoped sequence/audit evidence, repair-policy contract/code, and regression tests, but the project does not yet implement a reusable Harness/runtime selector contract for this hypothesis.
non_generalization: No persistent naming or generic face recovery claim.
No coordinate-only tie-break or choose-first selector behavior.
No runtime selector helper, runtime card, manifest, provider, SDK, IR, or training authority.

q01.contract: Only a frozen +Z single-cylinder prismatic record with exactly two adjacent planar terminal faces may be classified from measured cylindrical extent facts; every other count, axis, terminal-face, or footprint combination is unsupported.

q02.contract: The reviewed sequence is SketchRect, ExtrudeBase, then one record-specific +Z CutCylinder variant on the produced base; it is deterministic family evidence, not B-Rep-to-sequence inference.

mappings.boundary: The reviewed Q01/Q02 declared-stage contract is represented by an offline measured-fact audit and a frozen deterministic operation family. Q03 and Q04 are not declared stages for this hypothesis; no repair route, reusable Harness/runtime observation contract, or implementation claim is represented.
non_generalization: No generic cylindrical-feature recognition, non-+Z-axis, multi-cylinder, or imported-trimming claim.
No reference-script label, native-history, or B-Rep-to-sequence inference claim.
No runtime observation helper, runtime card, manifest, provider, SDK, IR, training, or hosted authority.

update_order: update the authoritative source or contract first
refresh this implementation-contract mapping and any declared relationship IDs
run the focused regression tests and governance audit
update derived navigation if the reader-facing implementation status changes
maintenance.drift_disposition: A missing path, changed hypothesis ID, unknown relationship ID, or widened implementation status is documentation drift. Repair the source-linked mapping; do not infer a runtime implementation or inspect fixtures/scripts to fill the gap.
maintenance.migration_boundary: M152 and M156 add development-side implementation-contract mappings only. They do not alter the M146 crosswalk, M150 case-evidence mapping, case metadata, manifests, runtime resources, or provider policy.
